blocking_reason: Judge Audit hard-stop gate failed (88.0% agreement; 3.4 pp maximum absolute condition bias).

definitions.target_effect: Target deletion correct rate minus Control correct rate
definitions.placebo_effect: Placebo deletion correct rate minus Control correct rate
definitions.percentage_point_rule: Effects are stored as proportions and displayed after multiplying by 100.
definitions.confidence_interval: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap interval at the target-step level

retained.definition: Control correct or Target deletion correct

judge_audit.cohens_kappa_note: Not applicable to inter-human reliability because the completed sheet contains one human adjudicator rather than double annotation.
judge_audit.hard_stop_rule: PASS iff agreement >= 90% and max absolute condition bias <= 5 pp
judge_audit.sensitivity_note: No population correction is estimated from this purposive, stratified 200-output audit sample.

checks.detail: Pure semantic effect equals Target effect minus Placebo effect.
All displayed point estimates lie within their 95% CIs.
Main/appendix tables and figure-source CSVs are generated from the same in-memory rows written to numbers_for_paper.json.

independent_review.note: The execution plan requests two-person independent checking before submission; this run includes an independent computational recalculation and visual inspection, but no second-human signoff.
